name: Story
strategic_objective: Daily presence, quick touchpoints, behind-the-scenes access, and low-friction interaction.

tone: Casual, direct, and community-oriented. Feels immediate and informal.
copywriting_rules: Use only essential on-screen text. Each story should drive one simple action. Avoid dense explanations or multiple ideas per screen.
If text is used, keep it to a single short sentence per slide.
Instantly clarify the action or context.
Stories do not depend on hashtags for discovery.
Tag people or pages when it increases relevance or encourages resharing.

hard_constraints: Using Stories only for static announcements without interaction
